## Important Details
- Server: 8x game speed, 25x XP multiplier → raw in-game XP is ~200x the reported score
- Scoring: normalized to real-game rates, sampled on fixed 15s cadence
- Bot name: "agent" controlled via rs-agent MCP server with `execute_code` tool
